description: Explicit opt-in NPU test candidates. The default full suite is not replaced by this manifest.

p0-candidate.description: Existing operator representatives and model smoke tests; not a complete P0 acceptance matrix or a performance gate.

kernels.description: Real NPU operator/reference checks and Ascend registration; synthetic inputs, no model weights.

model.description: Existing OneRec V1 public-API and graph shape-switch smoke tests; B1/B2, W8, not B1/B4 W128 acceptance.

coverage_gaps: The model tests do not provide the target B1/B4, per-request L128, W128, Prefill FULL plus Decode FULL matrix.
The existing graph model test requires B2 FULL replay and deliberately verifies B1 shape-miss fallback; that fallback must not be removed to claim B1 FULL coverage.
Direct XAttention reference cases cover B1/B2; the selected B4 attention case exercises Cascade, not the fused B4 XAttention path.
The BF16 constrained-TopK wrapper widens input logits to FP32; raw fused BF16 loader readiness remains a separately skipped known-precision case.
Long-context, repeated-request memory stability, online-service and calibrated performance acceptance are not supplied by these nodes.
Host-only cases validated in a separate runtime are not included as universal candidates.
